articles.headline: Neymar injury: Santos dismiss reports of lack of transparency over Brazil star's condition
articles.description: Santos have dismissed reports suggesting a lack of transparency from their medical staff regarding Neymar's physical condition and believe the player will be ready to play at the World Cup.

images.name: Neymar [1296x729]
images.credit: (Photo by NELSON ALMEIDA / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.headline: Neymar suffers calf injury, to miss Santos games ahead of World Cup
articles.description: Neymar has suffered a calf injury that will sideline him for Santos' upcoming matches, but he is expected to be ready next week to join the Brazil national team camp ahead of the World Cup.

images.name: Neymar Santos injury [1296x729]
images.caption: Neymar required treatment for a calf issue during Sunday's Santos match.

articles.headline: Santos manager explains substitute confusion involving Neymar
articles.description: Cuca discusses Neymar's unintended substitution during Santos' 3-0 defeat to Coritiba and states the officiating mistake was not responsible for the final result.

images.name: Santos manager explains substitute confusion involving Neymar
images.caption: Cuca discusses Neymar's unintended substitution during Santos' 3-0 defeat to Coritiba and states the officiating mistake was not responsible for the final result.

articles.headline: 'Brilliant' Neymar praised by Santos boss ahead of Brazil's World Cup squad announcement
articles.description: Santos coach Cuca praised Neymar following his team's 2-0 league win on Sunday, with Brazil close to announcing their World Cup squad.

images.name: Neymar Jr. [1296x729]
images.caption: Neymar opened the scoring on the stroke of half-time as Santos saw off Bragantino 2-0.
